what_this_is: The three browser-driven runs of the judge-selected REAL evidence source, made during the Step 13 walkthrough on the same local instance as 2026-09-09-judge-paired-rehearsal.json. Together with the two CLI runs in that file, this is the complete set of real Nokia runs this work produced: five runs, ten outbound attempts.
how_this_was_reconstructed: Read back from the signed verdicts the runs themselves produced, in the rehearsal instance's database, after the fact. The per-attempt transport records were not captured for these three at the time, so every duration and timestamp here is the investigator's own measurement inside the signed chain — a slightly wider interval than the transport figure, because it includes normalization. Nothing here is estimated: each value is a field of a signed verdict. Where a transport figure was captured, it is named in the run's own `context` line and is not mixed into the step measurements.
http_status: Not recorded per attempt for these three runs. What is recorded is stronger on the point at issue and weaker on the point of HTTP detail: each step carries a normalized signal with source `nac`, which this pipeline only produces from a 2xx response whose body parsed into the SDK's model. A non-200 would have produced PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE or EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE instead. So all six attempts returned usable responses; the exact status line is asserted only for the run whose panel was captured.

limitations: Local application rehearsal driven from a browser. Not evidence of deployed judge access.
Nokia account is in Simulator mode. No live-network subscriber was contacted.
Only the two boolean swap checks were exposed and attempted. retrieve-date was disabled in both modes.
All three used the greedy planner; the model-planned runs are the two CLI runs in the paired-rehearsal file.
Per-attempt HTTP status and transport duration were not captured for these runs; see `http_status` above for exactly what is and is not claimed.
completeness_check: The rehearsal instance's own stores were checked for a real run that reached Nokia and then failed before it could be saved, which would leave no chain: every run with journal events has a verdict event, and all 17 idempotency operations are 'done' — no reserved and no uncertain row, which is the state a run interrupted after provider work would have left. So five is the complete count for that instance, not merely the count that survived.
